title: Fix a crash from its error message (JavaScript)
prompt:
Running `{node} index.js` stops with this error:

    TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')
        at displayName (names.js:3:23)
        at Object.<anonymous> (index.js:5:15)

Some users have no profile, or a profile without a name. Fix displayName in names.js so that such users are shown as "(no name)". Do not edit users.json.
